The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] had a '''family'''.

==History==
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]]<ref name="Characters" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Denon/Legends|Denon]]<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" /> his family had a long history of military service with few [[Politics/Legends|political]] connections. Veers attended the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] and was promoted to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] following his actions during the [[insurrection on Culroon III]]. Soon afterwards,<ref name="Characters" /> between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]'' states that [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] [[Marriage/Legends|married]] his wife and [[Reproduction/Legends|had]] his [[Parent/Legends|son]], [[Zevulon Veers]], following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which took place in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', and that Zevulon was a teenager in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Therefore, the marriage and Zevulon's birth must have occurred by [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]] at the latest.</ref> Veers [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Maximilian Veers's wife|woman]] and they had their only son, [[Zevulon Veers]].<ref name="Characters" /> The family resembled the ideal loyal Imperial family described in [[Propaganda/Legends|propaganda]]<ref name="Databank">{{DB|character|generalmaximilianveers|Veers, General Maximilian}}</ref> Maximilian's wife [[Death/Legends|died]] of a rare disease during a family holiday. Maximilian poured himself into his work subsequently and encouraged his son to join the [[Army/Legends|army]] to honor her memory.<ref name="Characters" /> Maximilian was a strict disciplinarian rather than a caring father<ref name="Databank" /> and Zevulon questioned the Empire's values throughout his education.<ref name="DESB" />

Maximilian rose to the rank of [[General/Legends|general]], and was assigned to [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], the personal [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] group of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Characters" /> The family was propelled into the public eye following Maximilian's role in the Imperial victory against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], a part of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Fact File 45" /> Maximilian suffered severe injuries to his [[Limb/Legends|legs]] during the battle, but he refused [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] due to cultural prejudice against [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborgs]] and used a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] carriage to move afterwards.<ref name="Characters" /> The Imperial propaganda machine held up Maximilian as a "poster boy;" a loyal widower raising his son to follow in his footsteps.<ref name="Fact File 45" /> Maximilian and Zevulon took a period of short leave together, and both attended celebrations featuring speeches about the glory of the Empire and the immorality of the Rebellion.<ref name="DESB" />

Several [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] later, Zevulon defected to the Alliance during a routine political action where he saved a Rebel [[Unidentified librarian|librarian]] after he was [[Torture/Legends|tortured]] by his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], [[Ivo Laibach]].<ref name="DESB" /> The defection was a boon for the Alliance, as Zevulon was a talented [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and the defection was a significant embarassment to his father's career.<ref name="Fact File 45" /> Maximilian enjoyed his prestige following Hoth for several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] until he learned the truth about Zevulon's choice, and he would preferred for his son to have died.<ref name="Characters" /> Zevulon did not see or hear from his father again following the defection.<ref name="DESB" />

Maximilian continued his military service and was on a planetary mission when [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and Vader died at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], which destabalized the Empire. The general tried to find a powerful warlord to align himself with, but many of the surviving Imperials had resented Vader and treated Veers poorly because of his association. He eventually joined the resurrected Palpatine's [[Dark Empire]].<ref name="Characters" /> Zevulon continued to hold out hope that his family and father would reject the Empire.<ref name="DESB" /> Maximilian was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Dark Empire by the time of the [[Battle of Balmorra]]<ref name="Characters" /> in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]<ref name="Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> by which point he had lost his motivation and had suicidally thrown himself into the front lines, where he was killed by a dozen [[SD-10 battle droid]]s.<ref name="Characters" />
